subject: Q4 close: ownership for coverage shortfalls + stage clean-up
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-29T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Q4 close — pick owners for coverage gaps (Action needed)

Team,

We're 5 business days from quarter close and Finance flagged a set of coverage shortfalls vs. quota across our mid-market book. I've attached a one-tab template (Q4_Coverage_Gaps_template.xlsx) — please do the following by EOD Monday: 

1) Claim ownership for any account listed under your region. Reply-all with "I own: <account>" for tracking.
2) Update HubSpot stage to the best current state and set a realistic commit probability; if you're unsure, put a short note in the template.
3) If there are gating procurement or legal dates, add the expected decision date and contact in the template.

Key accounts called out: Acme Corporation (Procurement hold), HelioSoft (internal budget review), Nimbly Inc. (PO required).

We need clear owners so Finance can finalize the pipe-to-quota view. I'll consolidate responses and send a summary to Finance on Tuesday morning.

Thanks — this is time-sensitive.

—Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Director, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
